privacy.origin: Fully synthetic, generated from declared business intent. No customer export, chat row, numeric source ID, or live snapshot was copied.
privacy.VAT: Only blank or the literal placeholder UNKNOW; no tax validity is asserted.
privacy.identities: All source keys are invented textual business keys; no Odoo database IDs or credentials.

format.decimal_fields: French comma notation where shown; declare it in matching rules.
format.source_ids: Preserve as text, including AccountNum leading zeroes.

delivery_lifecycle.2026-04-15: Baseline182-row delivery candidate across11 CSVs; target exercises use separate NORTH/SOUTH execution projections.
delivery_lifecycle.2026-05-15: Complete62-row replacement of customer/party/address/payment-term input shape only. It excludes manufacturing and accounts by declared Recipe scope, and implies no target deletes.

file_grains.customers_core.csv: One customer account per Partition+CustomerRef; Party is a foreign key, not a globally unique customer key.
file_grains.party_details.csv: One party per Partition+RecId; source RecId is the counterpart of customers_core.Party.
file_grains.addresses.csv: One selected address per Partition+Party; this is deliberately a single-address view, not unrestricted one-to-many history.
file_grains.products_core.csv: One globally prefixed product reference; CompanyCode is available for source join scope, not automatic target ownership.
file_grains.product_details.csv: One exact enrichment row per CompanyCode+ProductRef; Name and Status are export labels distinct from product name/status.
file_grains.categories.csv: One supplied category per CategoryKey; ParentCategoryKey references the same table and blank means root.
file_grains.bom_rows.csv: One component line per BOMRef+Sequence with repeated header attributes; LineRef is the stable source trace key.
file_grains.bom_operations.csv: One operation per BOMRef+OperationRef; do not join to component lines.
file_grains.accounts.csv: One proposed account per CompanyCode+AccountNum; field-specific Odoo mapping is pending capability checks.
file_grains.payment_terms.csv: One intended payment term per CompanyCode+TermCode; source TermCode is not a promised native Odoo field.
file_grains.payment_term_lines.csv: One owned balance due-date line per LineKey and term; map through the child inverse relation after verifying captured metadata.
file_grains.customer_phone_patch.csv: One phone replacement per CustomerRef; only phone is a write field.

not_yet_covered_by_these_files: Native Excel date cells, formulas, multi-sheet selection, and named-table ranges need generated XLSX variants. CSV timestamps do not verify Excel ingestion.
Large 65,299/100,000-row and262-column cases need deterministic generated expansion with separate resource budgets.
API failures, lost replies, stale evidence, authorization, and restart/schema upgrades need controlled adapters or stored sanitized test state, not fake source rows.
No executable scenario definition, compiled Recipe, target seed adapter, or live qualification result is included.
